reason: Fixed HAL_RCC_OscConfig function by removing hardware-dependent while loops that wait for oscillator ready flags. In emulation environment without real hardware, these loops cause infinite waiting. The function is classified as LOOP type (functions containing loops influenced by MMIO/peripheral operations). All while loops waiting for hardware status flags (HSE, HSI, LSI, LSE, PLL ready flags) have been removed while preserving the configuration logic and returning HAL_OK to indicate successful initialization.
